rules.title: ADD
rules.desc: both inputs get the upstream gradient unchanged

rules.title: MUL
rules.desc: each input gets upstream × the OTHER input

rules.title: MAX
rules.desc: the larger input gets the gradient; ties split it 50/50

src.code:
(UPat(Ops.MAX, src=(UPat.var("x"), UPat.var("y"))), lambda ctx, x, y:
    ((x>y).where(ctx, (x.eq(y)).where(ctx * 0.5, 0)), (x<y).where(ctx, (x.eq(y)).where(ctx * 0.5, 0)))),

rules.title: WHERE
rules.desc: the condition gets nothing; each branch gets the gradient where it was selected

src.code: (UPat(Ops.WHERE, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: (None, ret.src[0].where(ctx, ctx.const_like(0)), ret.src[0].where(ctx.const_like(0), ctx))),

rules.title: RECIP
rules.desc: -upstream · ret²  (ret = 1/x, so -1/x²)

src.code: (UPat(Ops.RECIP, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: (-ctx * ret * ret,)),

rules.title: EXP2
rules.desc: ret · ln2 · upstream

src.code: (UPat(Ops.EXP2, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: (ret * ctx * math.log(2),)),

rules.title: LOG2
rules.desc: upstream / (x · ln2)

rules.title: SQRT
rules.desc: upstream / (2 · ret)

rules.title: SIN
rules.desc: sin(π/2 − x) · upstream  (= cos x, written with SIN so no COS op is needed)

src.code: (UPat(Ops.SIN, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: ((math.pi/2 - ret.src[0]).sin() * ctx,)),

rules.title: POW
rules.desc: e·b^(e−1) for the base, ret·ln b for the exponent, with special cases at 0
rules.tex: \partial_b b^e = e b^{e-1},\ \partial_e b^e = b^e \ln b

src.code:
(UPat(Ops.POW, name="ret", src=(UPat.var("b"), UPat.var("e"))), lambda ctx, ret, b, e:
    (ctx * e.eq(0).where(e, e*b.pow(e-1)), ctx * b.eq(0).where((e<0).where(ret.const_like(-math.inf), 0), ret*b.log2()*math.log(2.0)))),

rules.title: CAST
rules.desc: cast the gradient back to the input dtype

rules.title: TRUNC
rules.desc: zero: trunc is piecewise constant

rules.title: CMPLT
rules.desc: no gradient (None) to either side: comparisons are boolean

rules.title: REDUCE
rules.desc: ADD: broadcast upstream back to the input shape (reduce ↔ expand). MAX: mask of the argmax positions / tie count. MUL: product of the others

src.code: (UPat(Ops.REDUCE, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: reduce_gradient(ctx, ret, ret.arg[0])),

rules.title: REDUCE (MAX)
rules.desc: MAX case: the gradient goes to the argmax positions, split evenly between ties

src.code: (UPat(Ops.REDUCE, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: reduce_gradient(ctx, ret, ret.arg[0])),

rules.title: RESHAPE
rules.desc: reshape the gradient back to the input shape

rules.title: PERMUTE
rules.desc: permute back with the inverse permutation argsort(arg)

rules.title: EXPAND
rules.desc: pass the gradient through; compute_gradient then SUMS over the broadcast axes

rules.title: PAD
rules.desc: shrink the gradient back to the un-padded window

src.code: (UPat(Ops.PAD, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: (ctx.shrink(tuple([(p[0], s+p[0]) for s,p in zip(ret.src[0].shape, ret.marg)])), None, None)),

rules.title: SHRINK
rules.desc: pad the gradient with zeros back to the input shape

src.code: (UPat(Ops.SHRINK, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: (ctx._mop(Ops.PAD, tuple((p[0], s) for s,p in zip(ret.src[0].shape, ret.marg))), None, None)),

rules.title: STACK
rules.desc: each stacked source gets its slice ctx[i] of the gradient

src.code: (UPat(Ops.STACK, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: tuple(ctx[i] for i in range(len(ret.src)))),

rules.title: CONTIGUOUS_BACKWARD
rules.desc: identity in forward; makes the GRADIENT contiguous (a STAGE) in backward

rules.title: STAGE
rules.desc: contiguous() is a no-op for gradients: pass through

rules.title: COPY
rules.desc: copy the gradient back to the source device

rules.title: UNSHARD
rules.desc: re-shard the gradient on the same axis (multi-device, Chapter 19)

src.code: (UPat(Ops.UNSHARD, name="ret"), lambda ctx, ret: ctx.shard(ret.device, ret.axis).src),

rules.title: SINK
rules.desc: a SINK of several outputs hands each its own gradient

rules.title: STORE
rules.desc: assign: the stored value gets the gradient

src.code: (UPat(Ops.AFTER, src=(UPat(name="dest"), UPat(Ops.STORE, src=(UPat(name="dest"), UPat())))), lambda ctx,dest: (None, ctx)),

rules.title: AFTER
rules.desc: ordering / assign plumbing: route the gradient to the value or the call

src.code:
(UPat(Ops.AFTER, src=(UPat.var("d"), UPat(Ops.CALL, name="k"))), lambda ctx, d, k:
    (ctx, UOp.sink(*([ctx if i == k.src.index(d)-1 else UOp(Ops.NOOP) for i in range(len(k.src)-1)])))),
(UPat(Ops.AFTER, src=(UPat(name="dest"), UPat(Ops.STORE, src=(UPat(name="dest"), UPat())))), lambda ctx,dest: (None, ctx)),

rules.title: BITCAST
rules.desc: no gradient through a bitcast

rules.title: reduce_gradient()
rules.desc: the REDUCE rule's helper: ADD / MAX / MUL cases
